title: Update on Coordination of Services since Launch of Municipal Services Office
what_it_is: Update on Coordination of Services since Launch of Municipal Services Office

sections.label: Municipal Services Office improvement
sections.summary: Since MSO was set up in October 2014, response times for multi-agency cases fell from 21 to 12 days and referrals dropped from 13% to 9%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Since the Municipal Services Office (MSO) was set up in October 2014, there has been an improvement in the delivery of municipal services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The average time taken to respond to cases involving multiple agencies has been reduced by nine days, from 21 days in October 2014, when MSO was set up, to 12 days in June 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The proportion of cases which required referrals to multiple agencies has also dropped from 13% to 9% in the same period.

sections.label: OneService App and lead agencies
sections.summary: Initiatives included the OneService App and lead agencies: NParks for greenery, LTA as First Responder for connectivity infrastructure, and AVA for animal issues since 2012.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Some of the specific work initiatives included the introduction of OneService App which allowed feedback to be given without knowing or identifying the agency responsible for the problem and the appointment of lead agencies to deal with groups of municipal issues.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For example, public greenery maintenance has been centralised under the National Parks Board (NParks) since June 2015; the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has been appointed as the First Responder for feedback on maintenance of connectivity-related infrastructure since June this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Agri-Food and Veterinary Authority of Singapore (AVA) has also been appointed the First Responder for animal issues since 2012.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Members of public can contact AVA for all animal-related issues, including feedback on the presence of a python in a monsoon drain.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: AVA will coordinate efforts with the relevant agencies, including external partners such as animal welfare groups, to resolve the problem and be the lead agency to reply to the feedback provider.
